html: The common cold is a viral infection of the nose and throat. Most people recover in about a week to 10 days.

• Runny or stuffy nose
  • Sore throat
  • Cough
  • Mild body aches or a low-grade fever

• Wash hands often with soap and water
  • Avoid touching your eyes, nose and mouth
  • Cover coughs and sneezes
  • Stay home when sick

image.alt: Illustration of hands being washed under running water
image.caption: Washing for at least 20 seconds helps reduce the spread of many viruses.
image.title: Illustration of hands being washed under running water

html: Seek care for a high or long-lasting fever, trouble breathing, a severe sore throat, or symptoms that get worse instead of better.
